acceptanceCriteria: tools/gate-affected-select is checked against a _test.go-only change; if it propagates to importers, it follows the V1-0984 rule (or documents why the gate stays conservative).
A test covers the gate selector's behavior.
body: Follow-up from V1-0984 (branch claude/v1-0984-affected-test-only, head 1fcc517e, 2026-10-07): `corvint affected` now selects only the owning package for a Go _test.go-only change (99 to 43 units on the reproduction). tools/gate-affected-select has its own selector for `make gate-affected` and was not checked; it may still over-select. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
title: gate-affected-select: check whether the gate selector also propagates _test.go-only changes to importers (V1-0984 follow-up)
